tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhal dkar po tshe 'phel gyi bdag mdun sgrub tshul tho// dbu mdzad kun dga' don grub la ched don/ ngor mkhan rin po che ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po dgung grangs nga bzhi'i lo 'dir thag ring phebs 'grul gyi sku gegs zhi ba dang / sde dge rgyal khab chen po lo grangs du mar bstan 'gro'i don spyi sger tshang ma rnam dkar thugs bskyed rmad po che ltar 'grub pa'i dge mtshan la brten pa ngor bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yun du bzhugs pa'i thabs khyad par can du 'gyur ba'i sku rim du dmigs zhag gsum ring mgon khang khyad 'phags byang du dam rdzas gsum bkram bskang dmigs gsum/ zhal dkar po tshe 'phel gyi gtor ma bum thod bcas bshams nas bdag bskyed lam dus/ dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar gsum/ tshad med bzhi nas go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol bar gtor ma brgya rtsa'i bdag bskyed bzhin la/ dril gsil ting shags gang yang mi dgos/ de nas rang gi snying khar pad+ma dmar po sogs nas/ tshe'i dngos grub thob par gzhung bzhin/ sngags phreng 'khor/ rgyud la skyes par gzhung bzhin/ rlung 'dzin shes na dang / ma byung yang chog rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum sogs nas spros bral gyi ngang du bar gzhung bzhin la gyur zhes brjod/ rang skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi he ru kar gyur zhes dang / dkar po tshe 'phel gyi gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po nas/ thim par gong bzhin/ gtor chung nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gtor bsngo ltar bsngo zhing / phyi nang mchod pa phrin bcol bcas gtor bsngo bzhin gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ chi li babs pas bar gong bzhin/ de'i mdun phyogs na bzhugs pa'i bsgrub bya mchog gi dbu gtsug nas zhugs sku lus kyi nang thams cad nas thon bar gong bzhin/ oṃ nas/ de wi bar gong bzhin/

wā gin+d+ra dharmā pā la/ bha dra ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swāhā sbyar ba sum brgya so gsum/ slar yang thugs ka nas/ rang bzhin gyi bar gong bzhin/ bsgrub bya mchog gi sku lus kyi nang thams cad la khyab pas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par gyur zhes dang / gong gi sngags bzhi brgya zhe bzhi bzlas la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dkar po tshe 'phel gtso 'khor lngas bsgrub bya mchog gi sku tshe'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / sku tshe sku bsod thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la gtor bsngo bskang ba rgyun bzhin la yig brgya sum brgya/ thugs dam ma mgo dbyangs zhal la rgyas pa lha mchog ma rdzogs nas rtsa ltung bshags pa bdun bstod ma/ hūm̐ yig ma/ mjug chog gi brtan bzhugs khang gtor ma la'ang brtan bzhugs/ grol nyin mdun bskyed 'dod gsol rdzogs nas gtso 'khor lngar gsal ba 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun du zhu nas bsgrub bya mchog gi dbu gtsug tu thim zhes brjod dges bcas 'gyur che smin grub rmi ltas bzang ngan gsal 'tshal// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ zhal dkar po tshe 'phel gyi bdag mdun sgrub tshul tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
